name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private /evi-first Evidence Lane workflow with fresh-window State Travel, intersection-capable ENV15 mode routing, eighteen immutable sectors, automatic exit sealing, exact-APPROVE Fuse, prompt-indexed rollback, and capability-based durable persistence.

interface.shortDescription: Run /evi with verified fresh-window PV State Travel.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane displays /evi-00-state-travel first, atomically performs Boot plus locked ENV/UOP Flash through /evi-01-boot, keeps /evi-mode available for intersecting ENV15 modes, Chat Lineage, and a derived Planning-mode projection, accepts one explicit Git or local-code source, governs one project/agent/task across eighteen deterministic SQLite/MMD/DOT sectors, preserves an append-only universal Delta lifecycle, automatically seals task exit candidates, Fuses only exact APPROVE, enters accepted bytes through a fresh verified Codex task or ChatGPT chat, supports six-way HIL plus prompt-indexed pointer-only rollback, and keeps the governed session active until /evi-exit-boot.
defaultPrompt: Run /evi-00-state-travel first; if a handoff is pending, verify it in this fresh host window and wait.
Run /evi and resume my persistent Evidence Lane state.
Use /evi-mode at any point to classify an ordered mode intersection and its canonical lanes; Planning updates only the derived control-plane projection.
Use /evi-02-git or /evi-03-local, then select any ordered source-intake command before /evi-30-build-pv-entry.
Use /evi-50-task-plan and /evi-51-backlog for append-only Delta states and explicit history-preserving DROP or SUPERSEDE.
Complete one bounded task, automatically seal its exit candidate, and stop at HIL.
At HIL, show the returned suggested next prompt visibly before waiting; never choose or submit it for me.
